apps_guide_text: 📲 Useful Apps + Guide to Entering Italy 🇮🇹 🎓 University and Services Apps: 🔹 MyUnipg – University App: Download 🔹 MyUnipg Job – Job Opportunities: Download 🔹 Adisu Card – For Mensa: Download 🔹 FortiClient VPN – Connect to University Network: Download 🛍️ Shopping and Discounts: 🔹 University Box – Student Discounts: Download 🔹 Too Good To Go – Discounted Food: Download 🔹 The Fork – Restaurant Discounts: Download 🔹 Everli – Online Supermarket: Download 🚍 Transportation: 🔹 Moovit – Bus Routes: Download 🔹 Salgo – City Bus: Download 🔹 Flixbus – Intercity Bus: Download 🔹 Weelo – City Bike: Download 🔹 OMIO – Travel Booking: Download 🔹 Trenitalia – Train: Download 🔹 InTaxi – Ride-Hailing: Download 🏠 Accommodation: 🔹 Immobiliare – House Search: Download 🔹 Idealista – Rent House/Room: Download 💳 Financial and Banking: 🔹 Revolut – Bank Card: Download 🔹 Wise – Money Transfer: Download 🔹 Aruba PEC – Official Email: Download 🗺️ Tourism and Utilities: 🔹 Visit a City – Attractions: Download 🔹 Radical Storage – Luggage Storage: Download 🔹 Live Camera of Perugia Center: Watch 🌐 Guide to arival procedures in Italy: 1️⃣ Codice Fiscale: 📍 Agenzia delle Entrate or Online: Create 2️⃣ Permesso di Soggiorno: 📍 Main Questura 📍 Student Questura 3️⃣ University Enrollment: 📍 Esse3 Website 📍 Segreteria Studenti 📍 Unicredit Bank 4️⃣ Insurance: 🔗 WAI Insurance – €125 5️⃣ Bank Account Opening: 📍 Poste Italiane 6️⃣ Vaccine / Test / Green Pass: Visit local pharmacies 7️⃣ Appointment at CAF for ISEE: 🔗 Book an appointment ✳️ Tip: It is recommended to buy a 10-ride bus ticket from a Tabaccheria (~€13) and install the Moovit app.
